en: Vintage monochrome postcard showing a large hilltop castle with multiple towers and ramparts, surrounded by defensive walls and overlooking a valley. The central building is rectangular with many small windows and sloped roofs, set against distant mountains. The title 'CASTEL CLES (Val di Non)' is printed in red at the top right, with a faint handwritten date or note beside it. The lower part of the card is mostly blank, as typical for early picture postcards.
